status: candidate—not yet independently validated in compiler-backed hosted CI

semantics.mirrored_methods: public synchronous instance members, by name and explicit value arity
semantics.static_methods: not mirrored in v1; future explicit class facade
semantics.generated_name_resolution: reject collisions across modules and explicit imports; reject imports capturing the target or Proxy intrinsic; reject unresolved wildcard imports
semantics.overload_identity: name + explicit value arity; ambiguity rejects before generation
semantics.annotation_forwarding: reject annotated target constructors and annotated forwarded methods until metadata is compiler-checked; never drop contracts
semantics.borrowed_or_callable_signature: reject recursively on borrowed, callable, inferred, or mutable struct signatures until lifetime/effect/ownership lowering is proven
semantics.wrapped_target_return: fail closed on direct or nested target-typed returns until identity-preserving proxy adaptation is proven

required_negative_cases: static method mistakenly treated as instance
nested borrow and function-valued parameter transport
direct or nested Foo return bypasses FooProxy
imported target-name capture (Foo import vs local Foo)
mutable struct value signature, including nested position
evidence_policy: Use exact PR head + Git tree + nonzero executed jobs and steps + compiler-backed guest output; steps=[] and steps=null are runner admission failures and are not evidence.
